fluff.overview: The Pwwka was one of three Land-Air 'Mechs comprising the Word of Blake's Spectral LAM series, introduced in 3078 during the final years of the Jihad. Built by Master's Wings Aerospace on Gibson, the thirty-ton Pwwka was designed to fulfill the light reconnaissance and strike role that earlier LAMs had once occupied during the Star League era. Its appearance on the battlefield came as a profound shock to both coalition and Free Worlds League provincial forces, as LAM technology had long been considered extinct. Named for shape-shifting spirits from ancient Welsh mythology, the Pwwka earned a reputation as one of the rarest and most enigmatic BattleMech designs of the Jihad era.
fluff.capabilities:
The Pwwka mounts three Clan-manufactured ER medium lasers (one in each arm and one in the head) providing respectable firepower for its weight class without any ammunition dependency. Ten double heat sinks manage the thermal load effectively, allowing sustained laser fire in most engagements. A single-ton bomb bay in the center torso offers limited ordnance delivery capability, though in practice this storage was frequently repurposed for additional fuel to extend the LAM's critically short flight endurance.

Powered by a GM 180 fusion engine, the Pwwka achieves ground speeds of up to ninety-seven kilometers per hour and can jump one hundred eighty meters via six GM ATO 100 jump jets. In AirMech mode it reaches considerably higher speeds, and full aerospace conversion allows thrust ratings competitive with light fighters. However, the inherent constraints of LAM conversion equipment prevent the use of many advanced technologies common to Jihad-era designs, leaving the Pwwka unable to match the performance of dedicated BattleMechs or aerospace fighters of comparable tonnage. Its small cockpit (almost certainly designed for cybernetically enhanced Manei Domini pilots) and light Durallex Divine Protector armor further limit its survivability in sustained combat.
fluff.history:
By the mid-thirty-first century, Land-Air 'Mechs had been effectively extinct for decades. The destruction of LexaTech Industries' facility on Irece by Clan Nova Cat in 3050 eliminated the last known LAM production line in the Inner Sphere, and the inherent fragility and technological complexity of conversion equipment ensured that surviving examples dwindled rapidly through attrition. The widespread consensus among military analysts was that LAM technology was a dead end, a relic of a bygone era with no future on the modern battlefield.

The Word of Blake's Spectral LAM series shattered that assumption. Developed in secret at the former Brigadier Corporation plant on Gibson (rechristened Master's Wings Aerospace under Blakist control) the three Spectral designs including the Pwwka emerged in the late 3070s during the closing stages of the Jihad. The source of the Clan-grade weaponry mounted on the Pwwka has never been conclusively identified, representing one of many unanswered questions about Word of Blake procurement networks during the Jihad era.

The Pwwka saw action in limited numbers, always operating alongside Manei Domini units. Its primary engagements were against aerospace and ground forces belonging to the Principality of Regulus and the Duchy of Oriente, both of which were conducting operations against Blakist holdings in the former Free Worlds League. Scattered reports suggest that a small number of Pwwkas may also have engaged allied coalition forces, though confirmed encounters remain rare.

The design's operational lifespan proved extraordinarily brief. The Principality of Regulus launched a devastating raid against Gibson in 3079 that completely destroyed the Master's Wings Aerospace facility, the only known production source for the Pwwka. Combined with the broader defeat of the Word of Blake, this ensured the Pwwka was effectively extinct by 3081. Everything presently known about the design comes exclusively from the analysis of wreckage salvaged by Regulan and Oriente forces, lending the Pwwka an air of mystery that few other BattleMech designs possess.
fluff.deployment: The sole production model, this variant was deployed exclusively by Word of Blake Manei Domini formations during the final stages of the Jihad. Observed only in engagements against forces from the Principality of Regulus and the Duchy of Oriente, the Pwwka always operated as part of combined Manei Domini strike elements rather than as an independent unit. No factory variants are known to exist, and given the extremely limited number produced, it is possible that other configurations were built but never encountered by opposing forces.
